opening: I have a large lump in my left armpit.
I first noticed it 3 years ago, as a small lump that wasn't tender.
It stops me from bringing my left arm all the way in against my side.
Now there are stretch-mark-like streaks on the skin over it.
My only medication is a contraceptive implant, etonogestrel, in my left arm.

opening.text: I have a large lump in my left armpit that's tender now. I first noticed it 3 years ago, as a small lump that wasn't tender. Now there are stretch-mark-like streaks on the skin over it, and it stops me from bringing my left arm all the way in against my side. My only medication is a contraceptive implant, etonogestrel, in my left arm.
